scenes.title: Create an account
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Waffles123 is entered; the password stays masked. Create account opens onboarding.
scenes.read: I’m M’hamed, and this is DelaStudy. Let’s create an account as Waffles123.

scenes.title: Personalized onboarding
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Grade → goal → subjects → route → Delaware school → rhythm → saved study plan.
scenes.read: Onboarding asks for my grade, goal, subjects, school, and study rhythm. Each choice builds a saved plan, so I can return to my own workspace instead of starting from a blank screen.

scenes.title: The student’s desk
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Today opens with the saved account and its course plan.
scenes.read: Today brings that plan into one place.

scenes.title: Find a course
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Browse All, AP preparation and College; search Geometry.
scenes.read: The library has high school, AP preparation, and introductory college paths. Filters and search help me find the right course.

scenes.title: A complete course structure
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Geometry’s course outline and expandable units.
scenes.read: Each course has five units and at least thirty activities.

scenes.title: Bite-sized lessons
scenes.speaker: Presenter 2
scenes.screen: The three Geometry reading steps advance; the source credit remains visible.
scenes.read: Lessons explain one idea at a time in three short steps. The code saves my position before advancing, so leaving the app doesn’t erase my place.

scenes.title: Practice, feedback and saving
scenes.speaker: Presenter 2
scenes.screen: Multiple choice → fill in 180 → drag and tap to match → feedback → saved activity.
scenes.read: Practice starts with multiple choice: I identify the vertical angles. Next, I fill in one hundred eighty degrees. For matching, I drag the first term, then tap to place the others. Each answer gets immediate feedback. Finishing saves this activity to Waffles123’s account.

segments.read: Practice starts with multiple choice: I identify the vertical angles.
Next, I fill in one hundred eighty degrees.
For matching, I drag the first term, then tap to place the others. Each answer gets immediate feedback.
Finishing saves this activity to Waffles123’s account.

scenes.title: Resources, not a wall of text
scenes.speaker: Presenter 2
scenes.screen: Biology Foundations’ separate Resources tab expands textbooks, full readings and videos.
scenes.read: Resources have their own tab. Animated categories organize textbooks, complete readings, and video links, keeping extra material out of the lesson flow.

scenes.title: College preparation
scenes.speaker: Presenter 2
scenes.screen: Open College & next steps; check Explore fields of study.
scenes.read: College planning turns a broad goal into smaller steps, including exploring fields of study and preparing questions for a counselor.

scenes.title: Plan the next session
scenes.speaker: Presenter 2
scenes.screen: Create and save Review angle relationships in Plan.
scenes.read: I add a specific study task, then use it to start a focused session.

scenes.title: Sound with visible playback
scenes.speaker: Presenter 3
scenes.screen: Brown noise plays, pauses and resumes. Its colored bars move only during playback.
scenes.read: Study sounds are optional. The colored waves animate while playing and stop when paused. The animation respects Reduce Motion, and iOS supports background audio.

scenes.title: A quieter study view
scenes.speaker: Presenter 3
scenes.screen: Zen shows the live Pomodoro countdown; upcoming tasks can be hidden.
scenes.read: Zen emphasizes the Pomodoro timer. I can hide upcoming tasks when I want fewer distractions.

scenes.title: One useful iOS notification
scenes.speaker: Presenter 3
scenes.screen: Enabled session-end alerts → iPhone Home Screen → one Study interval complete alert → tap → completed Focus session.
scenes.read: Session-end alerts are optional. When the interval finishes, iOS shows one useful notification. It appears on the Home Screen. One tap reopens the matching session.

It appears on the Home Screen.
One tap reopens the matching session.

scenes.title: Real progress, one student
scenes.speaker: Presenter 3
scenes.screen: Waffles123’s profile, earned study XP and Stats. End on the profile.
scenes.read: Waffles123’s profile shows the progress earned in this walkthrough. That’s DelaStudy: one place to learn, plan, and build a study routine.
